title: viburnum opulus f. hydrangeoides
intro: Viburnum opulus f. hydrangeoides, commonly known as Guelder Rose or European Cranberrybush, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to Europe, Western Asia, and North America. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The health benefits of Guelder Rose are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, diaphoretic, and expectorant properties, which help to lower blood pressure, alleviate cold and flu symptoms, and ease respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Guelder Rose include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
